title: af_join tracks an input buffer by the channel index instead of nb_buffers
live_proof: the fix's removed line is present verbatim in n8.0, n8.1 and n8.1.1 and absent from n8.1.2 onwards, so it is absent from the 9.0.1 pin; the pin governs the fidelity tier, not whether the fixture builds
object: an input frame's plane buffer, reached by av_frame_get_plane_buffer
lifetime_ender: the last reference is dropped when the input frames are freed, returning the payload to the pool
shape: reference never taken / reuse / stale read
fidelity: model-consumer, real allocator: buffer.c is upstream's, the dedup loop is transcribed, and the filter graph and the part of AVFrame it touches are reduced
distinguishing: the only case here where the defect is an absent reference rather than a retained pointer

native-fix-differential.oracle: the buggy arm reads the reissued storage at the same address; the fixed arm holds a reference so nothing is reissued
native-fix-differential.note: this pair differs by the upstream fix, not by protection

spatial.role: control for sublet: same binary and guest, one difference

sublet.oracle: fault at the labelled read probe

cheribsd-revocation.target: stock CheriBSD purecap, libc revocation enabled
cheribsd-revocation.oracle: the sequence completes: the storage never reached malloc, so it never entered the quarantine the revoker sweeps
cheribsd-revocation.control: the run's cheribsd-abi probe reports runtime_revocation=1 from CheriBSD's own malloc_revoke_enabled(), in the same guest, immediately before these cases
cheribsd-revocation.guest_default: preserved -- unlike the PoisonCap runs, this one does not disable the kernel default

poisoncap-spatial.role: control for poisoncap-protected: same binary and guest, one difference

poisoncap-protected.oracle: SIGPROT after the setup marker FF2_PROBE case=36 ready
poisoncap-protected.note: CheriBSD reports a process status, not a fault PC, so the marker is what separates this from an arbitrary crash: it is printed only once reuse at the same address has been checked
poisoncap-protected.si_code_note: not captured: the runner records a process exit status and 162 is 128+34, so the signal is derived, but si_code is not recoverable from an exit status and is not guessed here

native-detect.requires: the port's payload arena is one allocation, so ASan's silence here would measure the fixture rather than FFmpeg

backing.role: the informative negative: revocation exists here, at the backing allocation, and the pool never frees its backing but recycles out of it. This separates 'no mechanism' from 'a mechanism at the wrong point'

status: native pair and every arm above run 2026-09-20; all passed. Four systems compared, two matched controls and one intermediate beside them
